shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at (1,2) on the left with the mark at (3,2) on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The point (1,2) is excluded while the same input is still defined by f(1)=−8. Right image: The displayed function has no value at x=3.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker excludes its plotted height only. The filled marker vertically aligned with it supplies the actual output at that input. On the right, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=3.
